maria: Heads-up — noticed a perf + correctness regression on nightly after the mixed-precision tiling change (PR #4132). p50 stable but p95/p99 latency spikes and a few silent token corruption traces in long-chat tests (>1024 tokens).
aj: ugh. Seen examples? repro script? which model/config?
maria: repro on gpt-large-ish with kv-cache enabled and sequence length 1536. Run: `python bench_infer.py --model gpt-xl --seq 1536 --batch 1 --dtype fp8 --kv-packed true`
Output snippet: 
```
p50 latency: 72ms
p95 latency: 412ms (was ~120ms)
Throughput tokens/s: 1420 -> 400
Detected token mismatch at step 187: "the" -> "thé"
```
aj: thanks. I ran perf on one host (A100) — measured heavy time in matmul kernel selection fallback and unpack/dequant path. Flame graph shows more time in dequantize_and_pack() after the change. Might be extra memcopies due to tiling permutation.
devon: I repro on Ampere45 but NOT on H100 infra. Could be a kernel dispatch heuristic that prefers small-block FP8 GEMM on Ampere which has bad cache behavior for long KV rows.
emma: i also saw weird KV header misalignment in one trace: KV header len is 64 but runtime expects 56 when kv-packed and tiling switch is active. Could be an alignment offset introduced by the tiler.
ci-bot: Build 2026-03-07-4132-nightly failed: tests/inference/long_chat_kv_check.py::test_kv_integrity (flake). Full logs: https://ci.internal/reds/4132/failed
sre-bot: Alert: deploy pipeline auto-rolled back for canary group due to p95 > 300ms for inference-route /generate
aj: hypothesis: tiler change introduced an extra 8-byte pad for FP8 micro-tiles to satisfy vectorized stores, but the KV pack header layout didn't get updated — so when kv cache is reused the offset drifts by 8 and the matmul backend reads wrong scales for later layers -> silent corruption. Also tiling rearrangement triggers codepath that forces float->int8 calibration on the fly for act-quant kernel which is slower.
maria: +1 on padding hypothesis. I grepped PR and found a single commit that updates tile_stride but not KV packing offsets (see diff chunk: `tile_stride += (tile_stride % 16) ? (16 - tile_stride%16) : 0`).
devon: repro steps that isolate timing vs corruption:
1) run bench_infer with --no-tiler -> latency good, no corruption
2) run with --tiler -> latency regresses and token diff appears
3) run tiler + --force-bf16 => latency improves but not back to baseline; corruption disappears.
So corruption tied to tiler+fp8 path.
aj: quick debug snippet I used: 
```
# dump kv header & first 3 scale values
python -c "from runtime import kv; print(kv.header_bytes(), kv.layer_scales(0)[:3])"
```
Before change: header_bytes() == 56
After change: header_bytes() == 64
But runtime code assumes 56 for offset calculation in kv_reuse.c.
maria: interestingly, quant calibration step also changed in PR: calibration now computes scale = max(abs(min), abs(max)) * 1.02 (tiny safety margin). That pushes some values into saturation for fp8 e4m3 layout on a few layers, forcing fallback path which does per-tile dequant.
emma: i ran a microbenchmark: single-layer FP8 GEMM vs BF16 GEMM when dequant overhead included:
- BF16: 1.0x baseline
- FP8 native kernel (no dequant): 0.85x time (faster)
- FP8 with on-the-fly dequant+pack: 1.6x slower (due to mem copies + scale maths)
So if tiler triggers the dequant+pack path, it can be wildly worse.
aj: actionable triage plan:
- revert the tiler padding change in the tiling module and run nightly for a couple runs (maria)
- add assertion in kv packer to validate header_bytes against expected layout at runtime and fail fast (devon)
- add unit that exercises long-kv reuse with various tile_strides to CI (emma)
maria: started a local revert branch and running perf sweep. also saving failing traces to /var/tmp/tiler_traces/1749992222/
devon: I'll add the KV header assertion and a CI test. Quick sketch: `assert(kv.header_size == expected_header_size_for_version(ver))` and detect mismatches at load time.
aj: one more note: the kernel selector uses heuristics based on `seq_len % tile_height` which can flip preferred kernel for seq lengths near 1024/1536 boundaries. If the new tiler produces tile_height changes, selector flips and picks FP8 microkernel that expects tight packing. We should make selector consider kv_packing_layout and header_size as additional cost factors.
maria: filing bug & tracking: BUG-RT-5293. Owner: maria. Priorities: P0 for correctness + P1 perf for rollback decision. I'll post an update to #eng-runtime when revert hits canary.
emma: FYI i've also collected perf counters (L2 miss up ~2.3x on micro tiles) and will attach CSV to the bug.
ci-bot: nightly revert branch build started: https://ci.internal/reds/builds/1750
aj: good. if someone wants to repro locally, I put a small harness in tools/tiler_repro.sh (use `--seq 1536 --dtype fp8 --kv-packed`).
maria: thanks everyone. going to run longer soak on A100 and H100 to confirm hardware-specific differences. ping me if you need traces. :pray:
